name: Leaf
description: Leaf, a high-performance Paper fork, with a version-selectable and SHA-256-verified boot updater.
author: tommasobenatti@users.noreply.github.com

installation.content:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
cd /mnt/server
update_leaf() {
  command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  version="${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
  if [ "$version" = "latest" ]; then
    version=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf" | jq -er '.versions[-1]') || return 1
  fi
  version_json=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf/versions/$version") || return 1
  build=$(printf '%s' "$version_json" | jq -er '.builds | max') || return 1
  build_json=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf/versions/$version/builds/$build") || return 1
  filename=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.downloads.primary.name') || return 1
  sha256=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.downloads.primary.sha256') || return 1
  release="$version-$build"
  current=$(cat .leaf-build 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$current" = "$release" ] && [ -s "$jar" ]; then
    echo "[Leaf Updater] Build $release is already installed."
    return 0
  fi
  url="https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf/versions/$version/builds/$build/downloads/$filename"
  echo "[Leaf Updater] Downloading Leaf $version build $build..."
  curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o "$jar.download" "$url" || return 1
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha256" "$jar.download" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null || return 1
  mv -f "$jar.download" "$jar" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$release" > .leaf-build
  echo "[Leaf Updater] Leaf $release installed and SHA-256 verified."
}
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE}"
if ! update_leaf; then
  rm -f "$jar.download"
  echo "[Leaf Installer] ERROR: unable to install Leaf."
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o server.properties "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties" || true
fi
mkdir -p .pterodactyl
cat > .pterodactyl/leaf-start.sh <<'PTERO_LEAF_START'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
cd /home/container || exit 1
update_leaf() {
  command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  version="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-1.21.11}"
  if [ "$version" = "latest" ]; then
    version=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf" | jq -er '.versions[-1]') || return 1
  fi
  version_json=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf/versions/$version") || return 1
  build=$(printf '%s' "$version_json" | jq -er '.builds | max') || return 1
  build_json=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf/versions/$version/builds/$build") || return 1
  filename=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.downloads.primary.name') || return 1
  sha256=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.downloads.primary.sha256') || return 1
  release="$version-$build"
  current=$(cat .leaf-build 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$current" = "$release" ] && [ -s "$jar" ]; then
    echo "[Leaf Updater] Build $release is already installed."
    return 0
  fi
  url="https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf/versions/$version/builds/$build/downloads/$filename"
  echo "[Leaf Updater] Downloading Leaf $version build $build..."
  curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o "$jar.download" "$url" || return 1
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha256" "$jar.download" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null || return 1
  mv -f "$jar.download" "$jar" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$release" > .leaf-build
  echo "[Leaf Updater] Leaf $release installed and SHA-256 verified."
}
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
auto_update="${AUTO_UPDATE:-1}"
if [ "$auto_update" = "1" ] || [ "$auto_update" = "true" ]; then
  if ! update_leaf; then
    rm -f "$jar.download"
    if [ ! -s "$jar" ]; then echo "[Leaf Updater] ERROR: update failed and no runnable JAR exists."; exit 1; fi
    echo "[Leaf Updater] WARNING: update failed; starting the existing JAR."
  fi
else
  echo "[Leaf Updater] Automatic updates are disabled."
  if [ ! -s "$jar" ]; then
    echo "[Leaf Updater] ERROR: $jar does not exist."
    exit 1
  fi
fi
exec java ${JAVA_FLAGS:--Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=95.0 -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled} ${LEAF_FLAGS:--DLeaf.disable-vanilla-profiler=true} -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar "$jar"
PTERO_LEAF_START
chmod 755 .pterodactyl/leaf-start.sh

variables.name: Leaf / Minecraft Version
variables.description: Leaf version to track, for example 1.21.11. Use latest to follow Leaf's newest version. At every boot, the latest build of this version is selected.

variables.name: Server JAR File
variables.description: JAR filename used by the updater and startup command.

variables.name: Update on Boot
variables.description: Download the latest Leaf build for the selected version before every start. If the API is unavailable, the last verified JAR is retained.

variables.name: JVM Flags
variables.description: General JVM flags. Change only if you understand their memory and garbage-collector impact.

variables.name: Leaf JVM Flags
variables.description: Leaf-specific flags from the official documentation. FMA is intentionally not forced because it depends on CPU support.
